Title: Desarrollador/a de agentes
Industries: Insurance, Business Consulting and Services, and Financial Services
Description: ¡En AXA México, buscamos a quienes se atrevan a desafiar límites y a impulsar el progreso para un mundo mejor! Si no le temes a los desafíos, deseas crecer y dejar huella, esta es tu oportunidad para vivir esa experiencia que transforma vidas, incluyendo la tuya. ¿Estás listo para alcanzar tu potencial y hacer la diferencia? Únete a nuestro equipo y sé parte de una organización que respeta la diversidad, fomenta la inclusión y promueve la innovación. Aquí, cada paso que das te acerca más a la mejor versión de ti mismo. Objetivo del puesto: Liderar la integración de soluciones avanzadas de Inteligencia Artificial (IA Generativa y Machine Learning) como pilar fundamental para automatizar las operaciones y soportar los procesos de negocio de la organización, garantizando que cada iniciativa tecnológica esté estrictamente alineada con la estrategia corporativa y cumpla rigurosamente con los lineamientos, políticas de gobernanza y estándares de Grupo AXA. Principales funciones: Dirigir el ciclo de vida completo de los modelos de IA, desde la investigación y prueba de concepto (PoC) hasta el despliegue en producción y monitoreo (MLOps/LLMOps). Identificar y traducir problemas de negocio en soluciones avanzadas de Machine Learning e IA Generativa, garantizando que el diseño soporte las operaciones y automatice procesos clave. Diseñar e implementar sistemas basados en LLMs (Large Language Models), utilizando técnicas como RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), prompt engineering avanzado y fine-tuning para adaptar los modelos a las necesidades específicas de la organización. Establecer y auditar las mejores prácticas de codificación, revisión técnica de modelos y metodologías de experimentación para el desarrollo de IA. Asegurar la seguridad, gobernanza y ética de los modelos desarrollados, mitigando riesgos como alucinaciones, sesgos algorítmicos y exposición de información confidencial, en estricto cumplimiento con los lineamientos del Grupo. Actuar como referente técnico, guiando y elevando el nivel de otros especialistas en IA, científicos de datos e ingenieros de machine learning. Crear, administrar y dar mantenimiento continuo a agentes de Inteligencia Artificial (AI Agents) y ecosistemas multi-agente, asegurando su autonomía controlada, ejecución eficiente y conexión segura con las APIs y sistemas internos Requisitos: Licenciatura en: Informatica, Ingenieria, Estadistica, Acturia o a fin. Nivel de inglés: Avanzado (Indispensable) Conocimiento: Dominio experto de Python y las librerías estándar del ecosistema de inteligencia artificial (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn). Profundo conocimiento práctico en frameworks y ecosistemas de GenAI (ej. LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, OpenAI API). Conocimiento avanzado en prácticas de MLOps y LLMOps, abarcando el empaquetado de modelos, versionado de experimentos y despliegue eficiente para inferencia Experiencia 2+ años de experiencia práctica y demostrable (o participación en proyectos pioneros) trabajando con modelos de IA Generativa, frameworks de orquestación (ej. LangChain) y bases de datos vectoriales. Se valorará fuertemente haber escalado al menos un caso de uso de GenAI desde la prueba de concepto (PoC) hasta su operación. Experiencia demostrable en la implementación y despliegue de flujos de trabajo autónomos utilizando agentic frameworks (ej. LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen o similares), llevando soluciones basadas en agentes a un entorno funcional. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? En AXA México, te brindamos un camino para potenciar tus habilidades, crecer personal y profesionalmente, y vivir una experiencia que te desafíe a ser mejor cada día. Aquí, tu potencial es la semilla del cambio, y tu progreso, el impulso para transformar vidas. Nuestro compromiso contigo: Potencial: Brindarte autonomía para que tomes decisiones y lideres cambios. Progreso: Escuchar y acompañarte en tu desarrollo, ampliando tus capacidades humanas y profesionales. Cuidado: Garantizar tu bienestar integral, tanto en lo personal como en lo laboral. ¿Lista/o para dar el siguiente paso? Know You Can — porque en AXA, tu historia de éxito empieza ahora. Acerca de AXA ¿Alguna vez te has preguntado cómo sería trabajar en un lugar donde puedes alcanzar tu máximo potencial? Somos una compañía multinacional de origen francés, líder mundial en seguros, presente en 50 países, con más de 95 millones de clientes en todo el mundo. Desde 2008, en México, hemos protegido y cuidado a cerca de 5.9 millones de mexicanos, gracias a nuestros más de 5,000 colaboradores comprometidos. En AXA, celebramos la diversidad de ideas y pensamientos, porque nos hace más fuertes. Promovemos un entorno inclusivo, sustentable y lleno de espacios para aprender, colaborar y crear. Aquí, cada idea cuenta, cada voz es valorada y tu desarrollo es nuestra misión. Si quieres dar el siguiente paso y atreverte a hacer lo mejor de ti, AXA México te está esperando. Atrévete a vivir la experiencia AXA y construye un futuro lleno de oportunidades.

Description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description Job Description Summary The Engineer, Product Data Management (PDM), oversees the development of engineering processes. These processes involve departmental or teams, ensuring adherence to procedures during the release or modification of Rockwell Automation products or components. You will coordinate interdepartmental activities to support project completion according to schedule. You will manage PDM processes, such as Material Change Requests (MCR), Standard and Engineer to Order (ETO) projects, and engineering changes. The Engineer, Product Data Management (PDM), oversees the development of engineering processes with departmental or teams to ensure adherence to procedures during the release or modification of Rockwell Automation products or components. You will coordinate interdepartmental activities to support project completion according to schedule. You will manage PDM processes, such as Material Change Requests (MCR), Standard and Engineer to Order (ETO) projects, and engineering changes. You will report to: Team Lead, Product Data Management Your Responsibilities Coordinate material master workflows using SAP, Windchill, Agile Point, and other relevant tools. Help test, implementation, and training of new tools and procedures. Contribute suggestions for continuous improvement projects. Help manage processes, and techniques governing SAP data documentation for Teams within the PDM scope. Participate in projects. MCR, Standard, and ETO Support: Manage and synchronize global product data to facilitate sales, supply chain optimization, and logistics efficiency. Enforce product lifecycle management practices and uphold organizational data standards. Provide support for the validation, creation, and extension of saleable goods materials (MVOD Process). Collaborate with Project Managers, Customer Care, Component Engineers, Purchasing, and Manufacturing teams to resolve issues and fulfill requests. Research material vendor information to verify details provided by requestors, including ROHS compliance, manufacturing part numbers, and obsolete material replacements. Engineering Change Support: Coordinate the review, routing, and approval process for engineering change orders, ensuring actions by all participants to meet project implementation timelines. Work with ISC functions—Operations, Quality, Industrialization, Test, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, Certifications, and others—to define goals and achieve shared goals. The Essentials - You Will Have Bachelor's degree required (field of study flexible). Advanced English language skills (spoken and written). Engineering degree (Industrial, mechanical, electronic…) or a related technical discipline. Data Management experience in a manufacturing or services environment. Windchill, Agile Point, SAP experience. What We Offer Transportation allowance or gas allowance. Lunch allowance. Complementary medical insurance. Personal hours. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

Title: Business Intelligence Leader–Commercial Operations for ELECTRIFICATION

Description: En ABB , ayudamos a las industrias a funcionar de forma más eficiente y limpia, y cada una de las personas que trabajan aquí lo hace posible. Estarás capacitado para liderar, apoyado para crecer y orgulloso del impacto que creamos juntos. Únete a nosotros y ayuda a que funcione lo que hace funcionar el mundo. Este Puesto Reporta a EL Customer Operations Manager __ Your Role And ResponsibilitieS The position of Business Intelligence leader will initially focus on two KEY stakeholders: Customer operations (order fulfillment) and CI Quality for North America HUB Commercial Operations (US & Canada). The scope expands over: ELSP/SB order backlog, USA Regional Distribution centers & factory support for quality, order handling & customer service teams. The BI Leader will be expected to provide various marketing & order fulfillment reports to enable commercial operation strategy development for existing and potential customers, products and/or services. The work model for the role is: Hybrid with 4 days in office and 1 remote This role is contributing to the Electrification Smart Power / Smart Buildings divisions in North America . Main stakeholders are Customer Operations and Quality teams in the ELSP Americas HUB You Will Be Mainly Accountable For Competitive intelligence Works with data warehouses (snowflake database) and business intelligence tools (power BI) to provide analysis related to demand and sales trends as well as internal performance data like order management, order to remittance, disputes, etc. Actively engages with HUB leadership to contribute on strategic plans for improvement on internal KPIs for the USA Market, RDCs performance and productivity out of the San Pedro Office. Market analysis Prepares analyses of internal sales, technical and financial data, and external market data. Interprets resulting data and makes recommendations to leadership in preparation for marketing and sales monthly/quarterly updates. Build a robust sales performance analysis system regarding channels, segments, geographic areas, customers, products and services. Order Fulfillment Ability to analyze data and identify opportunities to increase operational efficiency for customer operations teams (customer service, planners, Key Accounts, order handling and post sales) and generate insights for Commercial Operations leadership that help drive the HUB 2026 strategy. Distribution center monitoring Inform management of orders & backlog analysis results that identify existing gaps or new opportunities for efficient operations and improve revenues & customer satisfaction. Being able to provide visibility towards open deliveries and opportunities related to stock available. Work together with HUB Continuous improvement – Quality leader and team to support our RDCs improvement plans. Qualifications For The Role Have a demonstrated track record in business intelligence and Proven experience working with Microsoft Power BI, Snowflake databases, SQL & Python. You are at ease communicating in English both Verbal and Written. Your Are a Right Fit If Your interests expand beyond dashboard development, we are looking for Business Intelligence insights. You are curious about systems like CRMs( Salesforce), WMS (Warehouse Management Systems) and ERPs (SAP). If you are interested in learning about Commercial Operations and OTR processes and engage in active communication of insights and analysis for decision making in a fast-paced Distribution & OEM operation. If you have an interest in working with continuous improvement teams to help them drive actions that will increase productivity and/or reduce OPEX for Commercial Operations. If you see yourself growing into a future manager role, increasing people leadership responsibilities as well as ownership of strategy and outlook. Construir un futuro más limpio e inteligente requiere todo tipo de mentes: las curiosas, las valientes y las creativas. Por eso acogemos a personas de todos los orígenes y experiencias. ¿Listo para causar impacto? Presenta tu candidatura hoy mismo o visita https://www.abb.com para saber más sobre el impacto de nuestras soluciones en todo el mundo.

Title: Acceleration Center - Digital Core Modernization (DCM) - SAP EAM Data Analyst - Manager
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: At PwC, our people in business application consulting specialise in consulting services for a variety of business applications, helping clients optimise operational efficiency. These individuals analyse client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilisation of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. In SAP technology at PwC, you will specialise in utilising and managing SAP software and solutions within an organisation. You will be responsible for tasks such as installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team member’s unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. Skills Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to: Analyse and identify the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system. Take ownership of projects, ensuring their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. Partner with team leadership to ensure collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables. Develop skills outside your comfort zone, and encourage others to do the same. Effectively mentor others. Use the review of work as an opportunity to deepen the expertise of team members. Address conflicts or issues, engaging in difficult conversations with clients, team members and other stakeholders, escalating where appropriate. Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements. Minimum Years Experience Required 8–10 years of overall experience in SAP environments, with a strong focus on Enterprise Asset Management (SAP EAM / SAP PM) and data‑driven roles. 3–5 years of experience working in SAP EAM data analysis, reporting, or analytics roles, preferably supporting SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA transformations. Proven experience leading teams or workstreams as a Manager, with responsibility for delivery quality, stakeholder management, and client engagement in enterprise or global delivery environments. Solid background handling large SAP data sets related to assets, maintenance, lifecycle management, and operational performance. Additional Application Instructions Strong expertise in SAP EAM (SAP PM) data structures, including asset master data, maintenance plans, notifications, work orders, and equipment hierarchies, with the ability to analyze, validate, cleanse, and transform data for reporting and business insights. Experience supporting Digital Core Modernization and SAP S/4HANA programs, including EAM data migration, data quality assessments, reconciliation activities, and post‑go‑live data support. Proficiency working with analytics and reporting tools such as SAP BW, SAP HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud, or equivalent reporting and visualization platforms to support asset and maintenance analytics. Ability to translate business and operational requirements into data insights, KPIs, and dashboards related to asset performance, maintenance efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization. Proven leadership skills to manage and mentor SAP EAM data analysts, collaborate with SAP functional consultants, architects, and business stakeholders, and engage directly with clients to manage expectations, risks, and delivery outcomes within a global Acceleration Center model.
